name: 🍖 Mighty Meatloaf
what: Two glazed meatloaves with broccoli on the same pan, and rice. Extra for lunch.

core.name: Eggs (2)
core.out: skip, add an extra splash of milk

extras: onion, broccoli, rice, brown sugar, worcestershire or soy sauce, milk, garlic powder

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 375°F. Foil on a sheet pan.
In a big bowl, soak the crumbs in a splash of milk 2 minutes. Add eggs, ½ cup ketchup, salt and pepper.
Add the meat and mix gently with clean hands just until combined. Shape two loaves on the pan.
Brush with ketchup mixed with a little brown sugar. Bake 35 min, then add broccoli to the pan and bake 20 more. Make the rice.

key: Mix the meat as little as you can. Squeezing it makes it tough.
done: 160°F in the middle, or the juice runs clear.
plan_b: Running late? Make burgers from the same mix: 4–5 minutes a side in a skillet.
